data.name: Nareshkumar
data.gender_notes: Nareshkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of the Earth, God of Courage
data.long_meaning: Nareshkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Naresh (Lord of the Earth) and Kumar (God of Courage). This name is associated with strength, bravery, and divine protection. It is believed that Nareshkumar embodies the power of the earth and inspires courage in those who bear this name. The name Nareshkumar carries the meaning “Lord of the Earth, God of Courage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nareshkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the earth, god of courage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divine protection and courage in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Nareshkumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Earth, God of Courage.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nareshkumar total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: Nareshkumar is a Hindu name of great prestige in Indian culture, resonating with a deep sense of power and nobility. It's a title once held by medieval rulers who were revered as the earth's protectors. The name highlights the spiritual connection that many Hindus have with the land, viewing it as a living deity. The name Nareshkumar, thus, carries a rich cultural legacy that represents strength, valor, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Nareshkumar is considered auspicious and spiritually significant. The name embodies the energy of earth, as represented by Naresh, in union with the courageous persona connoted by Kumar. It signifies the brave warrior spirit that battles the trials and tribulations of life, encouraged and sustained by the divine energies of the land. It is often believed that a child named Nareshkumar has a deep inner power and strong moral character that helps him navigate life's challenges successfully.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nareshkumar: The name Nareshkumar is derived from two Sanskrit words. 'Nareesh' meaning 'Lord of Men' and 'Kumar' meaning 'Young Prince'. This name symbolizes the spiritual journey of an individual toward becoming a ruler of their own inner world, a young prince of the soul. It represents the courage, leadership, and wisdom required on this path of self-realization.
